column1: Mobility: the 20-minute routine and the splits session

20-min routine after both climbing sessions (Mon, Sat) and on Wednesday evening
22-min splits session on Thursday evening. Each slot includes the change to the next exercise; the timer can wait for your tap instead. Wrist drills after climbing only, at the very end.

Intensity: a clear, tolerable stretch sensation with normal breathing
No number is a target. Static or contract-relax, your choice: at the tolerable point contract gently for 5-6 s, relax, exhale, settle
No forced deepening.

Dose: each stretch slot is about 6 min a week at three sessions, inside the 5-10 min per position where gains level off. Retest every 4-6 weeks (shoulder screen, straddle, high-step and knee-to-wall checks on the Archive tab)
Once a shoulder test passes, give its slot to the weakest position instead. Range partly regresses within 2-6 weeks off.
